Author: Haven contributors; Enceladeum (native engine)
Name: Haven
Description: Personal housing interiors without owning a house: the full furnishing catalogue, lighting, music and atmosphere, saved on your PC. Host gatherings for friends to visit and decorate together. Everything is drawn on your own client; your character never leaves the spot you entered from. Invite-only alpha: gatherings need a Haven account and an access code. Requires Stagehand.
Punchline: Housing interiors of your own, to furnish and share for roleplay.
